```{r echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ISLR2)
library(ggplot2)
library(DALEXtra)
library(GGally)
library(tidymodels)
library(kableExtra)
library(splines)
library(ggfortify)

```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(Auto, aes(weight, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title= "Weight versus mpg for a sample of cars",
    x = "Vehicle weight in pounds",
    y = "Average miles per gallon of gasoline",
    subtitle = "Figure 1"
  )



```

```{r}
mod1 <- lm(mpg~weight, data=Auto)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(mod1)
glance(mod1) |>
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC) |>
  kable(digits = 3)

mod2 <- lm(mpg~poly(weight, 2), data=Auto)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(mod2)
glance(mod2) |>
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC) |>
  kable(digits = 3)

mod3 <- lm(mpg~poly(weight, 3), data=Auto)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(mod3)
glance(mod3) |>
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC) |>
  kable(digits = 3)

mod4 <- lm(mpg~poly(weight, 4), data=Auto)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(mod4)
glance(mod4) |>
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC) |>
  kable(digits = 3)

```

```{r}
glance(lm(mpg ~ bs(weight, df=3), data = Auto)) |>
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC) |>
  kable(digits = 3)

ggplot(data=Auto, aes(x=weight, y=mpg)) +
  geom_point(aes(x=weight, y=mpg)) +
  geom_smooth(formula =y ~ bs(x, df=3), method="lm")


glance(lm(mpg ~ bs(weight, df=4), data = Auto)) |>
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC) |>
  kable(digits = 3)

ggplot(data=Auto, aes(x=weight, y=mpg)) +
  geom_point(aes(x=weight, y=mpg)) +
  geom_smooth(formula =y ~ bs(x, df=4), method="lm")


glance(lm(mpg ~ bs(weight, df=5), data = Auto)) |>
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC) |>
  kable(digits = 3)

ggplot(data=Auto, aes(x=weight, y=mpg)) +
  geom_point(aes(x=weight, y=mpg)) +
  geom_smooth(formula =y ~ bs(x, df=5), method="lm")


```
